pwa.installed: Joidy installed! You can now access it from your desktop.

welcome.title: Welcome to Joidy
welcome.content: Your personal knowledge management system with gamification. Here you'll take notes, set goals, and grow a plant while keeping daily streaks.

notes.title: Create your first note
notes.content: On the Notes page you can create and organize your knowledge. Each note supports tags, icons, and colors, and syncs with your Obsidian vault.

tags.title: Tags and graph
tags.content: Tag your notes to connect them. The Graph visualizes how your notes relate through tags, revealing patterns and themes in your knowledge.

goals.title: Your first goal
goals.content: Set goals with timeframes (daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly). Completing goals gives you XP and fuels your progress. Start with something small and achievable.

streaks.title: Streaks and plant
streaks.content: Keep a daily activity streak. Every day you interact with Joidy you earn XP and your plant grows: from seed to tree. Don't break the chain!

obsidian.title: Connect Obsidian (optional)
obsidian.content: Joidy syncs with your Obsidian vault to keep your notes in Markdown format. You can set it up now from Settings, or skip this step and do it later.

settings.title: SETTINGS
settings.themeAutoHint: The theme will change based on the time of day and season
